annotations.title: Decode and lint a certificate signing request (CSR)

description: Decode and lint a certificate signing request (CSR) — Decode a PEM PKCS#10 CSR offline and check it before you send it to a CA. text= (PEM CSR, URL-encoded) or url= (.csr/.pem file). Returns subject, SANs (DNS/IP/email/URI), key type/size/curve, SPKI SHA-256 pin, signature algorithm and whether the self-signature verifies, requested key usage/EKU/basicConstraints. Flags what CAs reject: RSA under 2048, SHA-1/MD5 signatures, broken signatures, missing SAN, CN not in SAN, internal names and private IPs, CA:TRUE, unsupported curves, Ed25519 for public TLS, challengePassword, bad country code. Verdict READY / REVIEW / FIX BEFORE SUBMITTING. Private keys are refused and never echoed. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_csr_decode
